title: Allosteric autoregulation of DNA binding via a DNA-mimicking protein domain: a biophysical study of ZNF410-DNA interaction using small angle X-ray scattering.
authors: Kaur, Gundeep; Ren, Ren; Hammel, Michal; Horton, John R; Yang, Jie; Cao, Yu; He, Chenxi; Lan, Fei; Lan, Xianjiang; Blobel, Gerd A; Blumenthal, Robert M; Zhang, Xing; Cheng, Xiaodong
one_liner_zh: 该文结合AlphaFold预测与SAXS实验，研究ZNF410转录因子通过DNA模拟结构域自抑制DNA结合的变构调控机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作且采用AI结构预测方法，高度匹配课题。
abstract: ZNF410 is a highly-conserved transcription factor, remarkable in that it recognizes a 15-base pair DNA element but has just a single responsive target gene in mammalian erythroid cells. ZNF410 includes a tandem array of five zinc-fingers (ZFs), surrounded by uncharacterized N- and C-terminal regions. Unexpectedly, full-length ZNF410 has reduced DNA binding affinity, compared to that of the isolated DNA binding ZF array, both in vitro and in cells. AlphaFold predicts a partially-folded N-terminal subdomain that includes a 30-residue long helix, preceded by a hairpin loop rich in acidic (aspartate/glutamate) and serine/threonine residues. This hairpin loop is predicted by AlphaFold to lie against the DNA binding interface of the ZF array. In solution, ZNF410 is a monomer and binds to DNA with 1:1 stoichiometry. Surprisingly, the single best-fit model for the experimental small angle X-ray scattering profile, in the absence of DNA, is the original AlphaFold model with the N-terminal long-helix and the hairpin loop occupying the ZF DNA binding surface. For DNA binding, the hairpin loop presumably must be displaced. After combining biophysical, biochemical, bioinformatic and artificial intelligence-based AlphaFold analyses, we suggest that the hairpin loop mimics the structure and electrostatics of DNA, and provides an additional mechanism, supplementary to sequence specificity, of regulating ZNF410 DNA binding.
abstract_zh: ZNF410是一种高度保守的转录因子，其显著特点在于识别一个15碱基对的DNA元件，但在哺乳动物红细胞中仅有一个响应性靶基因。ZNF410包含五个锌指（ZFs）的串联阵列，其两侧是未表征的N端和C端区域。出乎意料的是，全长ZNF410在体外和细胞中与分离的DNA结合ZF阵列相比，其DNA结合亲和力降低。AlphaFold预测了一个部分折叠的N端亚结构域，其中包括一个30残基长的螺旋，其前是一个富含酸性（天冬氨酸/谷氨酸）和丝氨酸/苏氨酸残基的发夹环。AlphaFold预测该发夹环紧贴ZF阵列的DNA结合界面。在溶液中，ZNF410是单体，并以1:1的化学计量比与DNA结合。令人惊讶的是，在无DNA情况下，实验小角X射线散射谱的最佳拟合模型是原始AlphaFold模型，其中N端长螺旋和发夹环占据ZF DNA结合表面。对于DNA结合，发夹环可能必须被移位。结合生物物理、生物化学、生物信息学和基于人工智能的AlphaFold分析，我们提出发夹环模拟DNA的结构和静电特性，并提供了一种补充序列特异性的机制，用于调控ZNF410的DNA结合。
